intro: How much Atlas may do on OKX without asking you first.
levelsNote: Raising the level asks you to confirm first. Lowering it takes effect at once.
a1: Every trade passes the risk engine’s nine checks first.
a2: Every order carries a stop-loss on OKX’s own servers.
a3: Stop trading, on every page, halts it all at once.
a4: You’re told when an order fills, a stop is hit or trading pauses.
largestNote: {{largest}} is the most your next trade can use today, set by {{link}}.
waits: When a trade waits for you
timeout: If you don’t answer in time
waitsNote: A waiting trade shows in the toolbar on every page, with the time left.
historyNote: Each change is a new settings version, sent to the risk engine straight away.

t.on3: Trades up to {{amount}} go to OKX without asking. Saved as version {{v}}.
t.on4: Every approved trade goes to OKX without asking. Saved as version {{v}}.
t.low1: Nothing goes to OKX. Saved as version {{v}}.
t.low2: Every trade waits for your approval. Saved as version {{v}}.
t.low3: Trades above {{amount}} wait for you again. Saved as version {{v}}.
t.amountBody: Atlas asks you about trades above {{amount}}. Saved as version {{v}}.
t.failBody: It’s still level {{n}}. Atlas’s server didn’t answer.

err.title: Couldn’t load autonomy
err.body: Atlas’s server didn’t answer. Check that Atlas is running with ./atlas up, then try again.

firstMonth: Available from {{date}}, after your first live month.
firstMonthNote: Your first live month runs until {{date}}. Until then Atlas stays at level 2 or below.
